InventorFireworkTechnicianDI1.png|{{Color|Showtime|Inventor}} skin's weapon on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} FireworkTechnicianThumbnailClean.png|Default skin on a render. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The {{Color|Showtime|Inventor}} skin is a submission co-created by [https://x.com/Kingkas02 Kingk02] and [https://x.com/BMoon023 blueguy1011]. ==Update History== *'''31 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0|v1.47.5c]] **'''Firework Technician''' added. **{{Bug}} Default skin's torso is made out of grey plastic. *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **New skin: {{Color|Showtime|Inventor}} **{{Bug}} {{Color|Showtime|Inventor}} skin's shirt is slightly moved at Level 1-2, revealing its torso. *'''31 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0|v1.83.7a]] **New skin: {{Color|EventMission|2026}} **{{Bug}} {{Color|EventMission|2026}} skin's tophat at Level 3 does not disappear when upgraded to Level 4, causing z-fighting with the Level 4 tophat. {{TowerNavBox}}{{ShadowTOC}}
